title: keryx shell spends fewer tokens than competing harnesses without losing quality

AC1.note: loadSessionLimits openai-codex reads context_window/max_context_window from /models (src/commands/model-limits.ts, subscription-models.ts; tests model-limits.test.ts incl. absent-field case). Live probe 2026-10-02: gpt-6.1-sol -> 272000 live-models (journal). Guard armed via makeAgentDeps.

AC2.note: Overflow -> compact once + retry once; second overflow ends the turn (src/commands/agent.ts, isContextOverflowError/parseOverflowLimits in context-guard.ts). Tests: agent.overflow-retry.test.ts (fake provider), agent.host-contracts.test.ts, context-guard.test.ts incl. Anthropic/Gemini wording (review r1 F-005/F-006).

AC3.note: estimateWithUsageAnchor = last provider input usage + chars/4 since; replay bytes counted; falls back without anchor (context-guard.ts). Tests: context-guard.test.ts incl. 600K-char replayed reasoning tripping needsCompaction where the old estimate does not.

AC4.note: anchorsAnnouncement: one full Anchors block then deltas; compaction re-emits one (src/session/anchors-announce.ts, compact.ts). Test: anchors-announce.test.ts 20-change test asserts exactly one full block and bytes = first block + deltas.

AC5.note: isOperatorMessage + injected marker; summary keeps every operator request >=500 chars, merges previous summary, lists files read/modified (src/session/compact.ts). Tests: compact.test.ts reproduces the 2026-10-01 pattern (3 trailing injected messages), legacy unmarked session, merge, file lists.

AC6.note: planPrune protects the newest 40K tool-output tokens (+ unseen batch), placeholder names a readable saved file, >=20K threshold, archive keeps originals, prune -> remeasure -> compact (src/session/prune.ts, agent.ts). Tests: prune.test.ts incl. one-operator-turn session, prune-collapse.test.ts, prune-spill-safety.test.ts, agent.host-contracts.test.ts.

AC7.note: spillToolOutput: >2000 lines or >50KB written in full to <session>/tool-output (unique name, 0600), model gets head+tail+counts+path+read_file/search_code hint (src/harness/tool/output-spill.ts). Tests: output-spill.test.ts asserts file content equals original; spill-read-access.test.ts. Live: long runner spilled 1 output (long-session-report.md).

AC8.note: Codex requests carry prompt_cache_key = session id, stable per session, different between sessions (openai-provider.ts; openai-codex-provider.test.ts). Live probe in journal: endpoint accepts the field; with session-id/thread-id headers cacheReadTokens 2304/2426 vs 0 without.

AC9.note: scripts/benchmark/replay-session-shape.ts + .test.ts (deterministic, synthetic, no project content): window 272000 (gpt-6.1-sol via AC1), threshold 231200; branch peak 96,783 < threshold; total 7,374,769 vs main-before 14,848,882 = -50.3% (journal, commit f0fb5aa2 numbers).

AC10.note: comparative-report.md + fixtures ablation-mutating-results-{openai-codex,codex}-gpt-6.1-sol.json: same model gpt-6.1-sol, 3 tasks x 2 variants x 3 seeds; keryx 12,628 mean uncached input per task (context-on) vs codex CLI 35,199 -> keryx lowest (+0.0%). opencode reference on nemotron-3-ultra-free reported separately (fixture committed).

AC11.note: comparative-report.md, context-on arm: keryx success 100% vs main baseline 100% (baseline-main fixture), repeated reads after compaction/prune 0 vs 0. Known limitation recorded by owner decision: long-session-report.md (both 0/22; branch re-read loop) moved to flow 388.

AC6: "Before each request, tool results outside a protected window (the newest 40K estimated tokens of tool output and the last 2 operator turns) are replaced in the outgoing request by a fixed placeholder naming the spill file, only when that saves at least 20K estimated tokens; `archive.jsonl` keeps the original text. Tests cover the threshold, the protected window and the archive content." -> "Before each request, tool results outside a protected window (the newest 40K estimated tokens of tool output, plus the operator message that started the current turn) are replaced in the outgoing request by a fixed placeholder naming a readable file with the full text, only when that saves at least 20K estimated tokens; archive.jsonl keeps the original text. Pruning acts inside a long single operator turn too. Pruning runs before compaction, and compaction runs only if the request is still over threshold after pruning. Tests cover the threshold, the protected window, a one-operator-turn session and the archive content." (Owner decision 2026-10-02: protecting the whole last 2 operator turns disables pruning in few-turn sessions (the motivating 2026-10-01 shape), leaving only the lossier in-turn compaction; protect the newest 40K tokens + the turn's operator message instead. No confirmations existed.)
